class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m)

  self.qadr=np.array([self.m.jnt_qposadr[j] if j>=0 else -1 for j in self.jids]); self.dadr=np.array([self.m.jnt_dofadr[j] if j>=0 else -1 for j in self.jids])
  for i in range(61):
   if self.qadr[i]>=0:self.q[i]=self.d.qpos[self.qadr[i]]
  self.q[:11]=[0,0,-.4,.8,-.4,0,0,-.4,.8,-.4,0]
  self.targets={};self.rots={}
  for side in ('lh','rh'):
   self.rots[side]=self.d.xmat[self.m.body(side+'_palm').id].reshape(3,3).copy()
  self.history=[]
 def fingers(self,side,close):
  b=21 if side=='lh' else 41
  self.q[b+2:b+7]=[.3,.8*close,0,0,.8*close]
  for j in (8,11,14,18):self.q[b+j]=.7*close
  for j in (9,12,15,19):self.q[b+j]=2.0*close
 def ik(self,side,pos,rot=None):
  ids=np.array(([11,12,13,14,15,21,22] if side=='lh' else [16,17,18,19,20,41,42]))
  bid=self.m.body(side+'_palm').id
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  self.k.qpos[self.qadr[ids]]=self.q[ids]
  jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy()
  for _ in range(12):
   mujoco.mj_fwdPosition(self.m,self.k)
   ep=np.array(pos)-self.k.xpos[bid]
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,jp,jr,bid)
   J=jp[:,self.dadr[ids]]
   if rot is not None:
    er=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@self.k.xmat[bid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
    J=np.vstack([J,.20*jr[:,self.dadr[ids]]]);ep=np.r_[ep,.20*er]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(len(ep))*.0003,ep)
   self.k.qpos[self.qadr[ids]]=np.clip(self.k.qpos[self.qadr[ids]]+np.clip(dq,-.15,.15),self.lo[ids]+.001,self.hi[ids]-.001)
  self.q[ids]=self.k.qpos[self.qadr[ids]]
 def step(self,targets=None,gravity=1):
  if targets:
   for side,v in targets.items():self.ik(side,*v)
  q=self.q.copy()

  for i in range(11,21):
   q[i]+=gravity*self.d.qfrc_bias[self.dadr[i]]/self.m.actuator_gainprm[i,0]
  a=np.clip(2*(q-self.lo)/(self.hi-self.lo)-1,-1,1)
  self.s.step(a);self.history.append(a.astype(np.float32))
 def move(self,side,pos,n=60,rot=None,close=1):
  p0=self.d.xpos[self.m.body(side+'_palm').id].copy(); self.fingers(side,close)
  for t in range(n):

   self.step({side:((1-u)*p0+u*np.array(pos),rot)})
 def report(self):
